Stack.description: Lays out children in a column (default) or a row

Grid.description: Children in equal columns (2 by default, up to 4), fewer when there is no room

GridItem.description: A Grid child that is span columns wide

Columns.description: Children of different heights packed into columns top to bottom (3 by default), like a board of cards

Card.description: A bordered box that groups related content. footer is a slot under a rule; color tints a "soft" card and marks the others with a stripe

CardHeader.description: Title and optional subtitle at the top of a Card. trailing is a slot at its right: a Tag, a Button, an Avatar

Tabs.description: Alternative views of the same subject, one visible at a time

TabItem.description: value is a unique id, trigger is the tab label

Accordion.description: Sections that open on a click, one at a time unless multiple is true: FAQs, details on demand

AccordionItem.description: One section of an Accordion; open: true starts it open

Carousel.description: One item at a time with previous and next: a few cards to flip through

Separator.description: A horizontal rule between sections, with an optional label in it

Header.description: The heading of a page or a section: a small eyebrow line, the title, a description. actions is a slot of Buttons at its right

TextContent.description: A paragraph or a heading of plain text

Callout.description: A colored notice with a title and a description. actions is a slot of Buttons under it

Button.description: A button. Without an action it sends its label to you

Icon.description: One icon, for a slot or a row

Avatar.description: A round badge with the initials of name, or an icon. status adds a dot

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping Avatars; past max they show as "+N"

User.description: A person in one line: an avatar, the name, a description. trailing is a slot at the right

Link.description: A text link that opens url on a click

Breadcrumb.description: A path of places, the last one the current

CodeBlock.description: Code or a command in monospace, with a Copy button

Empty.description: What to show when there is nothing: an icon, a title, a line, and what to do next

Feature.description: An icon with a title and a line under it: a point, a benefit, a shortcut. url makes it a link

Steps.description: A numbered step-by-step guide. With current (from 1), earlier steps show done and later ones to do

List.description: Rows of things: tasks, files, people, results

ListItem.description: One row of a List. leading is a slot at its left (an Icon, an Avatar), trailing one at its right (a Tag, a Button, a Sparkline, text). url makes the row a link

DataList.description: Labels and values: the facts of one thing

Field.description: One label and value, on an EntityCard or in a DataList

Tree.description: Nested things that open on a click: folders, an outline, an org chart

TreeItem.description: One node of a Tree; children are TreeItems

Stat.description: A headline number (KPI). change is a short delta like "+12%"; trend colors it. spark draws a small line of the numbers behind it

Progress.description: A labelled bar, or a ring, showing value out of max (default 100)

Sparkline.description: A tiny chart with no axes, for a slot or beside a number

Calendar.description: One month as a grid of days, with marked days. month is YYYY-MM (this month when left out)

CalendarMark.description: A day to mark on a Calendar, YYYY-MM-DD

Table.description: A table, column by column. Every Col has one value per row. pageSize pages a long one; a click on a header sorts

Col.description: One table column: a header and one value per row

BarChart.description: Vertical bars: compare values across a few categories, one or more series

Series.description: One named series of numbers, one per label

HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars: rankings, or categories with long names

LineChart.description: Lines over ordered labels (time): trends, one or more series

AreaChart.description: Filled lines over time; "stacked" shows parts of a total

PieChart.description: Shares of one whole, at most 6 slices

Point.description: One x/y point; label names it in the tooltip

Map.description: An OpenStreetMap map that fits its markers. route: true joins them in order (an itinerary)

MapMarker.description: A place on a Map, in decimal degrees

EntityCard.description: A person, place, project, package or other thing: its name, facts and tags

LinkCard.description: A page to open: a search result, a source, a file in a drive (hyper://). The whole card is the link

ProductCard.description: Something to buy or choose: price, a 0-5 rating, tags, a badge like "Best value"

EventCard.description: Something that happens on a date. date is YYYY-MM-DD when you know it

QuoteCard.description: A quotation, with who said it or where it is from

ProsCons.description: Two lists side by side, for and against

Timeline.description: Dated events in order: history, a changelog, a schedule

TimelineItem.description: One dated entry on a Timeline

CardGrid.description: Cards in as many columns as fit (one in a narrow sidebar)

Form.description: Fields the user fills in, and a button that sends you what they entered as their next message

Input.description: A one-line field of a Form

RadioGroup.description: Pick one of a few, all visible

Slider.description: A number between min and max

HomeGreeting.description: The greeting, the date and the Space

HomePins.description: The Space's pinned pages as thumbnails, and the button that adds one

HomeNeedsYou.description: What waits on the user's answer, with its buttons. Shows only when something does; the page adds it at the top when a layout leaves it out

HomeNotifications.description: Job results, notices and unread Messages

HomeJobs.description: The Jobs running now and the ones up next

HomeCards.description: Every card pinned to the home page, each as its own child of the Grid, Columns or Stack this is in

HomeList.description: A checklist Note of this Space, named by its title ("Chores", "Groceries"): its items, ticked and added to right on the page. Offers to make the Note when there is none

HomePhotos.description: The Space's newest photos, as thumbnails

HomeMembers.description: Who is in the Space, and how to invite someone. Only the user in a Space that isn't shared
